h1.en: Avoiding Cavitation is the heading; what to send in a concrete pump inquiry stays the subject

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for what to send in a concrete pump inquiry. The row to open is /products/electric-concrete-pumps. Email on the site configuration is PinjinHebei@Outlook.com and the phone is 19912003025. Electric 80 and HBT80-16 both print HBT80-1816-110 and then different outputs and distances. Diesel 60 does not print an aggregate cell, so your measured stone is the only figure Xingtai has. Use /en/contact/ or /zh/contact/, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com, or 19912003025. Diesel 60 and LZ-60 both print the string HBT60-13.132 and then different kilowatts, outputs and weights. The section title “What is Cavitation?” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是向河北品锦机械询盘混凝土泵要带哪些信息的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-concrete-pumps。柴油60没有骨料格子，因此你量到的石子是邢台唯一能用的数字。柴油60和 LZ-60 都印 HBT60-13.132，随后千瓦、输送量和重量不同。电动80和 HBT80-16 都印 HBT80-1816-110，随后输送量和距离不同。站点配置中的邮箱是 PinjinHebei@Outlook.com，电话是 19912003025。使用 /zh/contact/、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。节标题「气蚀是什么?」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

body.en: “What is Cavitation?” titles this part of the what to send in a concrete pump inquiry note. The figures stay the printed ones. question.en: Does “What is Cavitation?” replace Email on the site configuration is PinjinHebei@Outlook.com and the phone is 19912003025?
question.zh: 「气蚀是什么?」会替换「柴油60没有骨料格子，因此你量到的石子是邢台唯一能用的数字。」吗？

answer.en: No. Email on the site configuration is PinjinHebei@Outlook.com and the phone is 19912003025 remains the printed wording for what to send in a concrete pump inquiry.
answer.zh: 不会。柴油60没有骨料格子，因此你量到的石子是邢台唯一能用的数字。仍是向河北品锦机械询盘混凝土泵要带哪些信息已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Electric 80 and HBT80-16 both print HBT80-1816-110 and then different outputs and distances belong on the what to send in a concrete pump inquiry row?
